newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: ASB Bank cuts NZ variable mortgage rate to 9.4 pct.
newsitem.headline: ASB Bank cuts NZ variable mortgage rate to 9.4 pct.

text.p: ASB Bank said on Thursday it would cut its New Zealand variable home lending rate to 9.4 percent from 9.95 percent, effective immediatly for new loans and from May 26 for existing customers.
ASB also said it would reduce its one-year fixed home lending rate to 9.25 percent from 9.4 percent effective immediately for new customers.
"Recent releases from the Department of Statistics on inflationary conditions have resulted in a positive outlook for inflation and an easing in wholesale interest rates," ASB said in a statement.
"This has made it possible to reduce home lending rates for our customers."
Countrywide Bank cut its floating rate to 9.4 percent from the same level on Wednesday as lenders across New Zealand responded to lower wholesale rates and a better inflationary outlook.
